decoder: V=mean(MBON12)-mean(MBON01), coefficients +1/-1. Prefer larger V; exact ties choose A but fail strict margin acceptance. No fitting, normalization or clipping. Record M=V(A)-V(B).
feedback: Counterbalanced experimental aversive contingencies, NOT verified chess consequences. Direct stimulation of mapped PPL103 cells, never teacher parameter updates.
schedule: Unchanged alternating cue exposure: 4 acquisition, 12 reversal. Phase-wise pulse-count-matched shuffled control, absent pulse control and disabled plasticity control.
acceptance: All informative seeds need strict correct acquired and reversed margins, a reversal ranking sign switch, and target-signed phase improvements greater than 1e-7. Acquisition and reversal effects must each exceed absent and shuffled controls with one-sided sign-test p<0.05. Require exact persistence/reset/restoration, disabled invariance, matched pulses and fixed graph/nonplastic state. Every gate required; never retune after results.
recoveryPrediction: Log per-trial mean efficacy by MBON type and A-only/B-only/shared/neither directly stimulated KC membership. Compare acquisition/reversal efficacy, V and M. Recovery is a prediction to inspect, not inferred from a choice alone and not a separately tuned acceptance gate.
GF: Retain original frozen GF calibration/readout as diagnostic fields only; GF has no influence on choice or acceptance. Preserve previous GF failure reports.
retention: Exact software persistence, not biological retention.
scope: Fresh encoder seeds on the same board/actions, new engineered MBON output condition. Not biological action-circuit validation, omission-only learning, unfamiliar-position transfer, whole-model adaptation or puzzle feedback integration.
